question_text: A 15-year-old male presents to the emergency department with fever, malaise, and shortness of breath for 1 week. Further history reveals that the patient experiences swelling in his face in the morning that disappears as the day progresses. Physical exam reveals hepatosplenomegaly. A complete blood count shows WBC 84,000 cells/mL. Most of this patient's leukocytes are likely to express which of the following cell surface markers?
